_source:
A real 'Chemistry Form 2 Scheme of Work' (a real Zambian secondary school's Natural Science Department; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) was shared with this project via Drive, across a separate Term 1 document and a combined 'Term 2-3' document. This is a genuine gap fill — this app previously had no Chemistry Form 2 content at all (only Form 1). Cites the real official '2024 Chemistry Syllabus Ordinary Secondary Education Form 1-4' with real page citations (Term 1: pg. 22-26; Term 2: pg. 26-29).

The 'Term 2-3' document actually contains two separate week-by-week tables back to back — one for Term 2 and one for Term 3. Term 2's table has real new topic content (2.5 Acids, Bases and Salts, with real sub-topics 2.5.1-2.5.7). Term 3's own table, however, contains no new topic or sub-topic content of its own at all — every week of it is either 'COMPREHENSIVE REVISION... of 2.1 to 2.5', 'MID-TERM TESTS / MOCK EXAMS', 'EXAMINATION PREPARATION' (exam techniques, time management), or 'END OF YEAR EXAMINATIONS'. Since it names no new specific competences, Term 3 is genuinely absent from this file's 'terms' array — this is an honestly-disclosed real gap, not an invented backfill.

Each term document's own 'MID-TERM TESTS' and 'END OF TERM TESTS' weeks are excluded, since they name no new specific competences. Term 2's own 'REVISION (Term 1 & 2) All Topics' week and its three-week 'PRACTICAL SKILLS & REVIEW — Core Practicals' block are also excluded for the same reason — both are explicitly a review/consolidation of already-listed topics, carrying no topic/sub-topic number of their own.

Content/Concept column text is summarised into each sub-topic's own description; the scheme's own Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.1 Chemical Bonding
sub_topics.description: Definition of chemical bonding; types of bonding (ionic, covalent, metallic).

sub_topics.name: 2.1.2 Ions
sub_topics.description: Formation of ions (cations, anions); charges and valencies; common radicals.

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of ion formation in bonding

sub_topics.name: 2.1.3 Chemical Formulae
sub_topics.description: Assigning valencies; writing formulae using valencies/charges; naming compounds (binary, ternary).

sub_topics.name: 2.1.4 Ionic Bonding
sub_topics.description: Formation of ionic bonds; properties of ionic compounds; uses of ionic compounds.

competencies.description: Apply the uses of ionic compounds

sub_topics.name: 2.1.5 Covalent Bonding
sub_topics.description: Formation of single, double and triple bonds; properties of covalent compounds; uses of covalent compounds.

competencies.description: Apply the uses of covalent compounds

sub_topics.name: 2.1.6 Metallic Bonding
sub_topics.description: Metallic bonding model; uses of metals.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.7 Structure of Compounds
sub_topics.description: Simple molecular versus giant structures; structures of simple and giant compounds.

competencies.description: Classify compounds into simple and giant structures

sub_topics.name: 2.2.1 Chemical Reactions
sub_topics.description: Definition of a chemical reaction; types: combination, decomposition, displacement.

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of the principles of chemical reactions

sub_topics.name: 2.2.2 Chemical Equations
sub_topics.description: Word equations; balanced chemical equations with state symbols; net ionic equations.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.1 Rates of Chemical Reactions
sub_topics.description: Meaning of reaction rate; factors: temperature, concentration, surface area, catalyst.

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of rates of chemical reactions
Investigate factors that affect the rates of chemical reactions

sub_topics.name: 2.4.1 Oxidation and Reduction
sub_topics.description: Oxidation and reduction in terms of oxygen/hydrogen/electron transfer; oxidising and reducing agents.

sub_topics.name: 2.5.1 Composition of Acids, Bases and Salts
sub_topics.description: Chemical composition of acids, bases and salts.

competencies.description: Analyse the composition of acids, bases, and salts

sub_topics.name: 2.5.2 Acids
sub_topics.description: Classification of acids; basicity; physical and chemical properties of acids.

sub_topics.name: 2.5.3 Bases
sub_topics.description: Classification of bases; acidity; physical and chemical properties; uses of bases.

sub_topics.name: 2.5.4 Oxides
sub_topics.description: Types of oxides (acidic, basic, etc.); uses of oxides.

sub_topics.name: 2.5.6 Salts
sub_topics.description: Classification of salts; preparation of soluble and insoluble salts; water of crystallisation; uses of salts.

sub_topics.name: 2.5.7 Qualitative Analysis
sub_topics.description: Tests for cations (e.g. Al3+, NH4+) and anions (e.g. CO3(2-), Cl-); tests for gases; economic applications of salt analysis.

competencies.description: Investigate the chemical composition of salts
